title: QRCodePay Audit Record
description: Audit Record v0.2 - an on-chain-anchorable set of hashes and status references that bind one Payment Intent and per-payment confirmation to a reusable Payment Mandate, contract payment proof, Provider execution evidence, and refund state where applicable. Stores hashes and status references, never plaintext order, merchant, or PAYER contact content.

payment_intent_hash.description: Keccak-256 hash of the canonical Payment Intent for this concrete payment.

order_hash.description: Keccak-256 hash of the canonical order content for this concrete payment.

merchant_hash.description: Salted keccak-256 hash of the merchant identity for this concrete payment. Verifiable through selective disclosure without public enumeration.

mandate_hash.description: Hash of the reusable canonical Payment Mandate used to authorize this payment.

confirmation_hash.description: Hash of the PAYER or wallet-policy confirmation that binds this Payment Intent to one mandate usage.

transfer_tx_hash.description: Transaction hash of the supported digital-asset transfer or contract payment that funded the payment.

provider_receipt_hash.description: Keccak-256 hash of the Provider receipt for the executed last-mile payment. Binds Provider execution evidence to the concrete Payment Intent and mandate usage.

refund_claim_id.description: Optional internal refund claim identifier used when contract payment was received and a PAYER-verified refund flow is required. This is not a payment authorization.

refund_tx_hash.description: Optional transaction hash for an executed refund. Must be unique when present and should be linked to the verified PAYER refund address by off-chain records.

refund_status_timestamp.description: Optional RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC timestamp for the latest refund-specific status transition.

status_timestamp.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which the recorded status was set.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the payment at status_timestamp.
